- `trip_type`, `star`, and status are not editable here; changing the booked car class means cancelling and rebooking, because the class determines the fare.

**Restrictions:**
- Caller must own the trip (else 403) and the trip must exist (else 404).
- The trip must be 'pending'; if it has been promoted, cancelled, or expired the call returns 409.
- If `scheduled_for` is supplied it is re-validated to the 30-minutes-to-7-days window; outside that returns 400.
- Coordinates are WGS84 lat/lng; `scheduled_for` is RFC3339 UTC.

400.description: Supplied scheduled_for is under 30 minutes or over 7 days out

403.description: Caller is not a rider, or does not own this scheduled trip

404.description: No scheduled trip with this id

409.description: Trip is no longer pending (already promoted, cancelled, or expired)

post.description:
Cancels a still-pending scheduled trip so it will never be promoted to a live trip. Only the owning rider may cancel.

**Behavior:**
1. Load the scheduled trip and verify the caller owns it.
2. Require the trip to still be 'pending'; otherwise reject as already finalised.
3. Set status to 'cancelled' and record the cancellation reason.
- The request body `reason` is optional; when omitted the reason defaults to 'rider_cancelled'.

**Use Cases:**
- Rider abandons a future booking before the scheduler promotes it.

**Restrictions:**
- Caller must own the trip (else 403) and the trip must exist (else 404).
- Only 'pending' trips can be cancelled; an already promoted, cancelled, or expired trip returns 409.

403.description: Caller is not a rider, or does not own this scheduled trip

404.description: No scheduled trip with this id

409.description: Trip is no longer pending (already promoted, cancelled, or expired)

get.summary: Get the assigned captain's summary for my trip
get.description:
Return a rider-safe summary of the captain assigned to the rider's own trip: name, vehicle (make/model/color/plate), average rating, and lifetime trip count.

**Access Control:**
- The trip must belong to the authenticated rider (`rider_id` = token subject); any other rider gets 403.
- Captain tokens are rejected with 403 (this is a rider-only view).

**Privacy:**
- No phone number or other captain PII is exposed -- only what the rider needs to identify the car pulling up.

**Behavior:**
1. Load the trip; 404 if it does not exist.
2. Verify the caller owns it; 403 otherwise.
3. 404 if no captain is assigned yet (trip still `requested`).
4. Return the captain summary.

403.description: The trip does not belong to the caller, or the caller is not a rider

404.description: No such trip, or no captain is assigned yet

get.summary: Get the captain's live position for a rider's trip
get.description:
Return the last-known position of the captain assigned to this trip.

**Purpose:**
- This is the *snapshot* half of live car tracking; `rt:trip:{id}` over WebSocket is the *stream* half.
- Call it once when the tracking map opens (and again after a WebSocket reconnect) to paint the car immediately. Without it the map stays empty until the captain's next ping, which can be several seconds of blank map on every open.

**Returns:**
- `longitude`/`latitude` (WGS-84), plus `heading_deg`, `speed_mps`, and `accuracy_m` (each null when the device did not report it).
- `last_ping_at` (RFC3339), `online`, `age_seconds`, and `stale`.
- `stale` is true when the fix is older than 5 minutes (the same threshold the staleness sweep uses to force a captain offline). Render a stale pin faded and do not animate it.

**Behavior:**
- Mirrors the live stream exactly: it resolves only while the trip is `accepted` or `in_progress`, the same window in which pings are fanned out to `rt:trip:{id}`. Any other status returns 404, so a rider cannot keep tracking a captain after the trip ends.

**Restrictions:**
- Requires the JWT of the rider who owns this trip; any other rider, or a captain token, is rejected with 403.
- 404 when the trip has no captain assigned yet, or the captain has never pinged.

403.description: Caller is not the rider who owns this trip

404.description: Trip not found, not currently trackable, no captain assigned, or no ping on file

get.summary: Get rider-side proxy numbers for a trip
get.description:
Return the masked phone-proxy session for a live trip, requested by the rider on that trip.

**Returns:**
- The `ProxySession`: `rider_proxy_number` and `captain_proxy_number` are the masked numbers each party dials; the real phone numbers are never exposed.
- `provider`, optional `provider_session_id`, and `expires_at` (RFC3339; session TTL is 2 hours from allocation).

**Behavior:**
- Lazily allocates on first access: if no non-expired session exists for the trip, one is created via the number-proxy provider and persisted.
- Idempotent within the TTL window: a second call returns the same non-expired session.
- An expired session is re-allocated in place: the same row (same `id` and `created_at`) is updated with freshly masked numbers and a new `expires_at`, rather than inserting a new row.

**Use Cases:**
- The Customer App shows a call button once a captain has accepted, without revealing the captain's real number.

**Restrictions:**
- Requires the `rider` role (bearer token).
- The caller must be the rider on this trip, otherwise 403.
- The trip must be `accepted` or `in_progress` and have a captain assigned, otherwise 409.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trip ID to fetch the proxy session for

403.description: Caller is not the rider on this trip, or lacks the rider role

404.description: Trip (or its rider record) not found

409.description: Trip is not accepted/in_progress, or no captain is assigned/resolvable yet

get.description:
Returns the ordered list of intermediate stops on a regular trip. The caller must be the rider who owns the trip.

**Returns:**
- Each stop's `seq` ordering, WGS84 lat/lng, optional address, status ('pending' or 'reached'), and `reached_at` (null until the captain marks it reached).
- Empty array when the trip has no stops.

**Use Cases:**
- Render the rider's planned waypoints and their reached/pending progress in the Customer App.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trip ID whose stops are listed

200.description: The trip's stops in sequence order (possibly empty)

403.description: Caller is not a rider, or does not own this trip

post.description:
Appends an intermediate stop to a live regular trip. Only the owning rider may add stops, capped at 3 per trip.

**Features:**
- Auto-assigns the next `seq` (current stop count + 1) and starts the stop as 'pending'.

**Behavior:**
1. Load the trip and verify the caller owns it.
2. Require `trip_type` to be 'regular' (multi-stop is regular-only).
3. Require the trip status to be 'accepted' or 'in_progress'.
4. Reject when the trip already has 3 stops; otherwise persist the new stop.

**Restrictions:**
- Caller must own the trip (else 403) and the trip must exist (else 404).
- Non-regular trip type or a trip not in 'accepted'/'in_progress' returns 400.
- At most 3 stops per trip; a 4th returns 409.
- Coordinates are WGS84 lat/lng.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trip ID to add the stop to

400.description: Trip is not a regular trip, or not in 'accepted'/'in_progress' status

403.description: Caller is not a rider, or does not own this trip

409.description: Stop limit of 3 already reached

get.description:
Return the authenticated rider's own account record.

**Returns:**
- `id`, `phone`, `name`, `photo_url`, and `gender` ("m" | "f" | "unset").
- Block status: `blocked` flag and `blocked_reason` (null when not blocked).
- `created_at` / `updated_at` timestamps (RFC3339).

**Use Cases:**
- Hydrate the rider profile screen after login.
- Re-fetch the account to reflect server-side changes (e.g. a name update or block).

404.description: No rider account exists for the token subject

delete.description:
Permanently delete the authenticated rider's own account and personal data (App Store guideline 5.1.1(v): in-app account deletion).

**Password required:** the request body must carry the rider's current password (`{"password": "..."}`). It is verified server-side against the stored hash; there is no code path that deletes an account without a successful password check. A request that is not valid JSON, carries no `Content-Type: application/json`, or omits the `password` field is rejected by the framework before any deletion happens (415 / 422 / 400 -- see the status codes below). Those rejections come from axum itself, so their bodies are PLAIN TEXT, not this API's `{"error": ...}` envelope; clients must not try to parse them as JSON.

**Behavior:**
1. Rider-only: a captain or admin token is rejected with 403.
2. The live rider account for the token subject is loaded; if there is none (already deleted), 404.
3. The supplied `password` is verified against the stored hash through the SAME throttled gate as rider login: a locked account is refused with 429 and a blocked one with 403 before the password is looked at, a wrong password answers 401 with body `{"error":"wrong_password"}` and counts toward the lockout (5 failures -> locked for 15 minutes), and a correct one clears the failure counter. Nothing is deleted unless the password is correct.
4. Refused while a trip is in flight (any non-terminal status) -- finish or cancel it first, else 409.
5. The account is soft-deleted and anonymized: name, phone, photo, push token, and password hash are scrubbed, and the account is signed out of future logins. The phone number is freed, so the same person may register a fresh account later.
6. De-identified trip and payment records are retained where legally required (see the privacy policy).

**Client contract:**
- Only 204 and 404 end the session. On 204 (or 404, meaning already deleted), discard the stored JWT and return the user to the signed-out screen. Deletion is irreversible.
- A 401 is ambiguous by status alone, so branch on the BODY. `{"error":"wrong_password"}` means the password was rejected but the session is still valid: keep the user signed in, stay on the delete screen, and show an inline error on the password field. ANY other 401 (the bare body from the auth middleware, or `{"error":"unauthorized"}`) means the token itself is dead -- sign the user out normally, exactly as on every other endpoint.
- 400 / 415 / 422 are framework-level body rejections (malformed JSON syntax, missing `Content-Type: application/json`, missing or mistyped `password`) whose bodies are plain text, not the `{"error": ...}` envelope. 409 means an active trip is blocking the delete. 429 means the account is temporarily locked after repeated wrong passwords; the same lockout as login applies here. All of these leave the session and the account untouched.
- The rider's current token is not server-revoked and remains technically valid until it expires, but after a 204 the account can no longer be read or logged into. Always discard it client-side immediately.

204.description: Account deleted; discard the token and sign the user out

400.description: Malformed JSON syntax in the body (axum rejection; PLAIN-TEXT body, not the `{"error": ...}` envelope). Nothing was deleted

401.description: Branch on the body, not the status. Body `{"error":"wrong_password"}` = the password was wrong: keep the session and show an inline error on the password field. Any other 401 body (bare text from the auth middleware, or `{"error":"unauthorized"}`) = the bearer token is missing, invalid or expired: sign the user out

403.description: The token is not a rider token, or the rider account is blocked

404.description: No live rider account for the token subject (already deleted)

409.description: The rider has an active trip; finish or cancel it first

415.description: No `Content-Type: application/json` on the request (axum rejection; PLAIN-TEXT body). Nothing was deleted

422.description: Body is valid JSON but `password` is missing or not a string (axum rejection; PLAIN-TEXT body). Nothing was deleted

429.description: Too many wrong passwords: the account is temporarily locked (same 5-attempt / 15-minute lockout as login)

patch.description:
Partially update the authenticated rider's own profile.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` -- display name.
- `photo_url` -- avatar URL.
- `gender` -- one of "m", "f", or "unset".

Partial update: every field is optional and only the fields present in the body are written; omitted fields are left unchanged. The full updated record is returned.

**Restrictions:**
- When `gender` is supplied it must be exactly "m", "f", or "unset"; any other value is rejected with 400.
- A rider can only edit their own account (the target is taken from the token, not the body).

400.description: gender was provided but is not "m", "f", or "unset"

404.description: No rider account exists for the token subject

post.summary: Mint a presigned avatar upload URL
post.description:
Mint a short-lived presigned PUT URL so the rider can upload an avatar photo directly to storage, bypassing this API. Mirrors the captain-document upload flow.

**Returns:**
- `upload_url` -- presigned PUT target; PUT the raw image bytes here directly.
- `object_key` -- the deterministic key to persist via `PATCH /api/riders/me` as `photo_url`.
- `expires_in` -- seconds until `upload_url` expires.

**Flow:**
1. Call this endpoint to get `upload_url` + `object_key`.
2. PUT the image bytes to `upload_url` before it expires.
3. `PATCH /api/riders/me` with `{ "photo_url": "<object_key>" }`.
4. `GET /api/riders/me` returns `photo_url` as a short-lived presigned view URL.

**Notes:**
- The object key is per-rider, so a re-upload overwrites the previous avatar in place.
- With unmanaged (mock) storage the URLs are deterministic placeholders.

500.description: Storage backend failed to presign the upload URL

get.description:
List trips, optionally filtered by rider, captain, or status, with page-based pagination.

**Features:**
- Filters (all optional, combinable): `rider_id`, `captain_id`, `status`.
- Pagination: `page` defaults to 1 (min 1); `per_page` defaults to 20 and is clamped to 1..=100.
- Response carries `items`, plus the total matching count and the echoed `page` / `per_page`.

**Use Cases:**
- A rider listing their own trip history (`rider_id` = their id).
- A captain listing assigned trips (`captain_id` = their id).
- Admin browsing all trips in a given status.

parameters.name: rider_id
parameters.description: Filter to trips for this rider id

parameters.name: captain_id
parameters.description: Filter to trips assigned to this captain id

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by lifecycle status (e.g. requested, accepted, in_progress, completed, cancelled)

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page; defaults to 20, clamped to 1..=100

post.description:
Create a regular point-to-point trip request as the authenticated rider.

**Features:**
- Fare is computed server-side from a haversine distance between pickup and dropoff (WGS84 lat/lng) using the admin-configurable tiered normal-taxi rate.
- Tiered model: `base + (min(km, threshold) * tier1_per_km) + (max(km - threshold, 0) * tier2_per_km)`, then rounded UP to the nearest `round_to_iqd`. Defaults: base 2000, 250 IQD/km up to 10 km, 125 IQD/km beyond, rounded up to 250 IQD. All values are editable from admin settings (`pricing.regular_*`, `pricing.tier_threshold_km`, `pricing.round_to_iqd`).
- Fare and base fare are returned in integer IQD (no decimals).
- On creation the trip is fire-and-forget dispatched: a background broadcast publishes `beep.trip.requested` to the nearest captains.

**Behavior:**
1. Reject if the rider already has an active (non-terminal) trip.
2. Compute distance, per-km rate, and total fare; create the trip in status `requested`.
3. Spawn the dispatch broadcast (failures are logged, not surfaced to the caller).

**Restrictions:**
- Requires a valid bearer token; `claims.sub` is used as the rider id.
- One active trip per rider; a second concurrent request is rejected with 409.

201.description: Trip created in `requested` and dispatch broadcast started

409.description: Rider already has an active trip

get.description:
Return the authenticated rider's current active trip, or `null` when they have none.

**Purpose:** the recovery counterpart to the `409` on `POST /api/trips`. A rider whose previous trip was never closed (captain crash, missed completion, abandoned match) is blocked from booking; this lets the app find that trip and route the rider to the live-trip screen to cancel it, even after a reinstall wiped the local trip store.

**Active** means any non-terminal status: `requested`, `matched`, `accepted`, or `in_progress` (the newest such trip is returned). Terminal trips (`completed`/`cancelled`) never match.

**Returns:** `200` with the `Trip` object, or `200` with a `null` body when there is no active trip. Rider-scoped: resolves against the caller's own rider id, so a captain token gets `null` here.

200.description: The rider's active trip, or null when none

get.description:
Compute a pre-request fare estimate for a pickup/dropoff pair. Public: no authentication required.

**Returns:**
- `fare_iqd`: the total estimated fare in integer IQD (no decimals).
- `distance_km`: the haversine distance between pickup and dropoff (WGS84 lat/lng) in km.
- `base_fare_iqd`: the base fare component in integer IQD.
- `currency`: always `IQD`.
- Fare uses the admin-configurable tiered model: `base + (min(km, threshold) * tier1_per_km) + (max(km - threshold, 0) * tier2_per_km)`, rounded UP to the nearest `round_to_iqd`. `trip_type=abriyah` selects the Abriyah tiers/base; any other value (or omitted) uses the normal-taxi tiers. `zone_id` no longer changes the per-km rate (pricing is global per type).

**Use Cases:**
- Rider app showing an estimated price before the rider commits to a request.
- Abriyah pricing preview by passing `trip_type=abriyah`.

parameters.name: promo_code
parameters.description: Optional promo code to preview the discount (potential only; not per-rider).

parameters.name: star
parameters.description:
Desired car star class (1..3) for a normal-trip estimate; omitted = 1.
Ignored when `trip_type=abriyah`.

400.description: Malformed or missing query parameters

get.description:
Retrieve a single trip's full lifecycle record by id.

**Returns:**
- The complete `Trip` row: type, status, fare and base fare (integer IQD), distance, pickup/dropoff coordinates, captain id (null until accepted), per-rider fare/distance breakdown, and lifecycle timestamps.
- No participant filtering is applied: any authenticated rider, captain, or admin may read any trip by id.

**Use Cases:**
- Rider or captain polling the current state of their trip.
- Admin or support inspecting a specific trip.

post.description:
Captain claims a trip, moving it through the state machine to `accepted`.

**Behavior:**
1. Require a captain token; the captain id is taken from the JWT `sub`.
2. Validate the transition to `accepted` for the actor `captain` (`requested -> accepted` for regular, `matched -> accepted` for Abriyah).
3. For a `regular` trip, reject with 409 if the captain's star grade is BELOW the trip's `requested_star`. Equal or higher is accepted: dispatch widens an unclaimed offer to higher-graded captains after `dispatch.star_widen_after_seconds`, and the rider pays the tier they booked either way, so a better car is never a fare surprise. Abriyah (`matched`) trips ignore the star grade.
4. Reject if this captain already has an active trip.
5. Apply the optimistic-lock accept (`accept` for `requested`, `accept_matched` for `matched`); any other current status is a conflict.
6. On success, publish `beep.trip.accepted` and enqueue a `trip_accepted` push to the rider.

**Use Cases:**
- Captain app tapping Accept on a dispatched trip offer.

**Telling the three 409s apart** (the body `error` string is the discriminator, so surface it rather than a generic message):
- `captain star does not match the requested class` -- this captain is graded BELOW the booked class. Not retryable; the offer was never theirs to take.
- `captain already has an active trip` -- finish or cancel the current ride first.
- anything else -- another captain took it, or the trip was cancelled. Drop it from the queue and refresh.

**Restrictions:**
- Captain role only; a non-captain token is rejected with 403.
- One active trip per captain; a second accept is rejected with 409.
- Invalid source state yields 400 (illegal transition) or 409 (lost optimistic lock / stale status).

400.description: Invalid state transition to accepted

409.description: Captain graded below the trip's requested star, captain already has an active trip, or the trip is no longer acceptable

post.description:
Signal that the captain has reached the pickup point. This is a cue event only and does not change the trip status.

**Behavior:**
1. Require a captain token; the captain id is taken from the JWT `sub`.
2. Require the trip to be in `accepted`; any other status yields 400.
3. Require this captain to be the trip's assigned captain; otherwise 403.
4. Publish `beep.trip.arrived` and enqueue a `captain_arriving` push to the rider.
5. Return the unchanged trip (status stays `accepted`).

**Use Cases:**
- Captain app tapping I Have Arrived to notify the rider.

**Restrictions:**
- Captain role only; a non-captain token is rejected with 403.
- Only the trip's own captain may mark arrival.
- Trip must be in `accepted` state.

400.description: Trip is not in the accepted state

403.description: Caller is not a captain, or not the trip's assigned captain

post.description:
Cancel a trip on behalf of the caller. The cancelling actor is derived from the JWT role: `rider`, `captain`, or `admin` (any admin role).

**Behavior:**
1. Validate the cancellation `reason` against the allowed enum (changed_mind, wait_too_long, wrong_pickup, captain_late, safety, system_timeout, captain_blocked, other); an unknown reason yields 400.
2. Pre-validate the transition to `cancelled` for the derived actor, then apply the optimistic-lock cancel.
3. Fan out side effects: exactly one `trip_cancelled` push to the opposite party (rider-cancel pushes the assigned captain if any; captain/system/admin-cancel pushes the rider, and admin/system also push the assigned captain), carrying `data: {trip_id, cancelled_by, reason}`. A captain cancel is TERMINAL: the trip is NOT re-dispatched, and the rider is told to request a new ride.
4. Best-effort cancellation penalty: a rider who cancels after the captain had already committed (`accepted` or `in_progress`) is charged the admin-tunable `trip.cancellation_penalty_iqd`; free while still `requested`/`matched`. A charge failure is logged, never surfaced.
5. Best-effort reports rollup of the cancelled trip and reason.
6. Publish `beep.trip.cancelled`.

**Use Cases:**
- Rider abandoning a request, captain dropping an accepted trip, or admin/support force-cancelling.

**Restrictions:**
- Requires a valid bearer token.
- The reason must be one of the allowed values; an invalid reason or illegal transition yields 400.
- Cancellation not allowed in the current state (or a lost optimistic lock) yields 409.

400.description: Invalid cancellation reason or illegal state transition

409.description: Cancellation not allowed in the current state, or lost optimistic lock

post.description:
End the ride, transitioning the trip `in_progress -> completed` and writing the per-rider fare/distance breakdown.

**Behavior:**
1. Validate the transition to `completed` for the actor `captain`.
2. Write a single-rider breakdown (this trip's fare in integer IQD and distance in km keyed by the rider id) and complete with the trip's current version.
3. Publish `beep.trip.completed` and enqueue a `trip_completed` push to the rider.
4. Best-effort reports rollup (trip volume, revenue-by-zone, leaderboard) -- failures are logged, never surfaced.
5. Best-effort wallet charge of the fare from the rider's wallet (v1 in-wallet MockGateway). An insufficient-balance debit is recorded as a `failed` ledger row and logged; it never blocks completion.

**Use Cases:**
- Captain app tapping Complete at the dropoff.

**Restrictions:**
- Captain role only; a non-captain token is rejected with 403. The completing captain id is taken from the JWT `sub`.
- The captain must be `approved`; a pending/rejected/blocked captain is rejected with 403.
- Trip must be in `in_progress`; an illegal transition yields 400.
- A lost optimistic lock (concurrent update) yields 409.

200.description: Trip completed; fare charge attempted best-effort

400.description: Invalid state transition to completed

403.description: Caller is not a captain, or the captain is not approved

409.description: Concurrent update conflict (lost optimistic lock)

get.summary: List all ratings for a trip
get.description:
Retrieve every rating attached to a trip (rider->captain and/or captain->rider).

**Returns:**
- `items`: the ratings recorded for this trip, each with stars (1-5), optional comment, the rater seat, and timestamps. An empty list is returned when the trip has no ratings (this is a 200, not a 404).

**Use Cases:**
- Showing both parties' ratings on a completed trip.
- Admin reviewing feedback for a specific trip.

post.summary: Submit a rating for a trip
post.description:
Submit a 1-5 star rating after a trip completes. Direction is derived from the caller's role: a rider rates the captain, a captain rates the rider.

**Features:**
- Rating direction is set automatically from the caller's JWT role (rider->captain or captain->rider); no direction field is sent.
- One rating per rater per trip is enforced; the rater seat is recorded from the token.
- On success a `beep.trip.rated` event is published.

**Behavior:**
1. Reject if `stars` is outside 1..=5.
2. Require the trip to exist and be `completed`; otherwise 404 or 400.
3. Reject if this rater already rated this trip (one rating per rater per trip).
4. Require the submitter to be the trip's rider (rider->captain) or captain (captain->rider); otherwise 403.
5. Persist the rating and publish `beep.trip.rated`.

**Use Cases:**
- Rider rating the captain on the post-trip screen.
- Captain rating the rider after dropoff.

**Restrictions:**
- Requires a valid bearer token; the role decides the rating direction.
- Trip must be completed; stars must be 1-5; only a trip participant may rate; one rating per rater.

400.description: Stars out of range 1-5, or trip is not completed

403.description: Caller is not a participant in this trip

409.description: Caller has already rated this trip

put.summary: Edit a rating within the 7-day window
put.description:
Update a previously submitted rating, allowed only within the 7-day edit window and only by the original rater.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `stars` and/or `comment`. When `stars` is supplied it must be 1-5; partial updates apply only the supplied fields.

**Behavior:**
1. Reject if a supplied `stars` is outside 1..=5.
2. Require the rating to exist; otherwise 404.
3. Require the caller (derived from the JWT role) to be the original rater; otherwise 403.
4. Reject if the rating is already locked (7-day window elapsed); the repository also re-checks `locked_at IS NULL` as a race-safe backstop.

**Restrictions:**
- Requires a valid bearer token; only the original rater may edit.
- Edits are blocked once the 7-day window has expired (400).
- Stars, if present, must be 1-5.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trip id (UUID); path only, not used to locate the rating

400.description: Edit window expired, or stars out of range 1-5

403.description: Caller is not the original rater

post.description:
Begin the ride, transitioning the trip `accepted -> in_progress`.

**Behavior:**
1. Require a captain token; the captain id is taken from the JWT `sub`.
2. Validate the transition to `in_progress` for the actor `captain`.
3. Apply the optimistic-lock start using the trip's current version.
4. Publish `beep.trip.started`.

**Use Cases:**
- Captain app tapping Start once the rider is on board.

**Restrictions:**
- Captain role only; a non-captain token is rejected with 403.
- Trip must be in `accepted`; an illegal transition yields 400.
- A lost optimistic lock (concurrent update) yields 409.

400.description: Invalid state transition to in_progress

409.description: Concurrent update conflict (lost optimistic lock)

get.description:
Every active brand in the catalog, for the first step of the car picker during captain registration. Ordered for display: by popularity rank, so the makes common in Iraq (Toyota, Kia, Hyundai) come first and the rarest last, ties broken alphabetically by Latin name. A brand carrying no rank sorts after every ranked one.

Each brand carries both `name_en` and `name_ar`; the Captain App is Arabic-first, so show `name_ar` and keep `name_en` for search. No authentication required.

get.summary: List the models of one brand
get.description:
Active models for a brand, alphabetically by Latin name. Second step of the car picker.

An unknown brand id returns an empty list rather than a 404: the catalog is reference data, and a brand that has been deactivated should degrade to 'no models' rather than breaking the registration screen.

Type-ahead over the whole catalog. Matches the query against brand and model names in BOTH Arabic and English, so 'تويوتا', 'toyota' and 'corol' all find the right car. Results are ranked by similarity and capped at 25.

Use this instead of the two-step brand/model picker when the captain would rather type than scroll. The returned `id` is the `car_model_id` to send on registration, and `brand_id` is the matching `car_brand_id`.

A query shorter than 2 characters returns an empty list.

**Features:**
- No authentication required
- Returns only active zones; archived zones are never exposed
- Not filtered by city; returns active zones across all cities
- Each zone carries its polygon as WKT (lng/lat, SRID 4326) plus Abriyah pricing and room settings (integer IQD)

**Use Cases:**
- Draw serviceable areas on the rider map
- Let the Captain App know which zones are live

Fetch a single active service zone by UUID for the Customer and Captain apps.

**Returns:**
- The zone's polygon as WKT (lng/lat, SRID 4326), Abriyah per-km and base fare (integer IQD), women-only flag, and room settings
- No authentication required
- An archived (inactive) zone is treated as not found and returns 404, so archived zones are never exposed publicly

**Use Cases:**
- Look up the pricing and settings of a zone the rider tapped on the map

Catalog brand this captain's car was matched to (FK to vehicle_brands).
Null when the car was never resolved -- either the captain registered on
a build that predates the picker and the free-text `car_make` matched
nothing, or the make simply is not in the catalog.

car_model_id.description:
Catalog model this captain's car was matched to (FK to vehicle_models).
Null for the same reasons as `car_brand_id`, and the reason a captain can
be stuck at star 2: with no model there are no quality indices to grade
on, so grading falls back to age alone and never reaches premium.

car_plate.description: Vehicle license plate. Unique per captain.

car_year.description:
Vehicle model year (e.g. 2019). Null when not supplied. Drives the
automatic `star` grade at registration (see the vehicle classifier).

city_id.description: City this captain belongs to (FK to cities).

gender.description:
Gender. Allowed values: "m" | "f". Set at registration; this domain
exposes no update endpoint, so in practice it never changes afterward.

national_id.description: National ID number. Null when not supplied at registration.

phone.description: Normalized phone number: digits only, leading `+` stripped, 10-15 digits. Unique per captain.

rejection_comment.description: Free-text rejection note shown to the captain. Null unless rejected and a comment was given.

rejection_reason.description:
Reason code set when status is "rejected". Allowed values:
"documents_invalid" | "vehicle_unfit" | "identity_mismatch" | "existing_account" | "other".
Null unless the captain was rejected (cleared when reset to pending or approved).

star.description:
Car star grade set by an admin by eye (1..3; 3 = nicest). Defaults to 1.
Riders pick a star when requesting a normal trip and are matched only to
captains of that exact grade. Not used for Abriyah.

star_overridden_at.description:
When an admin last set `star` by hand. Non-NULL PINS the grade: a
vehicle edit re-grades only captains whose star no human has decided, so
this is the only way to tell a hand-pinned grade from one the classifier
produced. Null while the grade is automatic.

The pin is NOT one-way: `PUT /api/captains/{id}/star` with
`{"star": null}` clears it and re-grades the captain from their stored
car in the same call. (There is no background re-grade job in the
codebase -- 057 talks about one, but the grade only ever moves on a
vehicle edit or an admin call, so a pin with no way out would have
frozen that captain's per-km rate forever.)

star_review_requested_at.description:
When this captain's own vehicle edit asked for a grade INCREASE that was
withheld pending review. Null when there is nothing to review.

`PUT /api/captain/me/vehicle` is an unverified self-declaration, and the
star it produces sets the per-km fare (500/700/1000 IQD/km), so a
captain-initiated raise is stored as a request rather than applied: the
description and catalog ids move, `star` does not, and an operator
decides against the `car_registration` document. Cleared by either
super-admin lever -- `PUT /api/captains/{id}/star` or
`PUT /api/captains/{id}/vehicle` -- because both mean a human has now
looked. A downward re-grade is applied immediately and never lands here.

CheckoutRequest.description:
Request body to start a QiCard checkout. The caller's identity (owner) comes
from the JWT; the body declares what to pay for and how much.

amount_iqd.description: Amount in integer IQD (no decimals); must be positive.

target_id.description:
Fulfilment target. Required for "trip_fare" (the trip id) and "daily_fee"
(the activation id); omit for "wallet_topup".

CheckoutResponse.description:
Response to a checkout: the created order plus the hosted-form URL to open.
In sandbox auto-confirm mode `status` is already "paid" and `paid` is true,
while `form_url` is still the real QiCard sandbox link.

form_url.description: Hosted-form URL to redirect the payer to (real QiCard sandbox/prod link).

order_id.description: The created order id (poll `GET /api/payments/orders/{id}` for status).

paid.description:
True when the order is already settled (sandbox auto-confirm). The client
may proceed immediately instead of waiting for the redirect/webhook.

payment_id.description: QiCard paymentId, when the gateway call succeeded.

sandbox.description: True when this settlement was a sandbox auto-confirm, not a real charge.

status.description: Order status: "paid" already in sandbox auto-confirm, else "created".

City.description: A city the platform operates in (Baghdad, Erbil, Basra, Mosul, ...).

active.description: Whether the city is live for trips. False for cities seeded for future multi-city expansion that are not yet activated.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for fares in this city (e.g. "IQD").

timezone.description: IANA timezone the city operates on (e.g. "Asia/Baghdad"); descriptive metadata only -- stored and echoed back but not read by any business logic. Daily semantics use a hardcoded Asia/Baghdad constant regardless of this value.

updated_at.description: Last-update timestamp, RFC3339.

CollectedRevenue.description:
Live collected-revenue summary over a date range, sourced from the
transaction ledger (status='succeeded'). Replaces the Phase 9 accrued view.

collected_activation_fees_iqd.description: Sum of succeeded daily activation-fee charges over the range, in integer IQD.

collected_fare_iqd.description: Sum of succeeded trip-fare charges over the range, in integer IQD.

net_iqd.description: Net collected revenue: fares + activation fees minus refunds, in integer IQD.

refunds_iqd.description: Sum of processed refunds over the range, in integer IQD.

CreateAdminUser.description:
Internal admin-creation shape consumed by `AdminAuthService::create_admin` and
`PgAdminUserRepository::create`. It is NOT the body of any live OpenAPI endpoint:
admin creation is exposed via `POST /api/admin/users` in the admin_ops domain,
which consumes `InviteAdminRequest` (the legacy create handler was removed).

email.description: Login email for the new admin. The `admin_users_email_unique` DB constraint rejects duplicates.

name.description: Display name for the new admin.

role.description: Access tier to grant: one of "super_admin" | "operator" | "finance".

CreateCity.description: Request body to create a city (POST /api/admin/cities).

active.description: Whether the city is live for trips on creation. Null defaults to true.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for fares. Null defaults to "IQD".

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the city. Null defaults to "Asia/Baghdad".

CreatePaymentMethod.description: Request body to register a new saved payment method.

card_number.description:
Raw card number; the service extracts last 4 and tokenizes, storing only
the gateway token. Never logged. Required for `method_type` "card"; null otherwise.

set_as_default.description:
If true, mark this method as the owner's default. Null/false leaves the
current default unchanged.

CreateRatingDto.description: Request body to leave a rating on a trip.

comment.description: Optional free-text comment. Null when omitted.

CreateRefund.description: Request body to open a refund against an existing transaction.

amount_iqd.description:
Amount to refund in integer IQD (no decimals); must be positive and not
exceed the original transaction amount.

transaction_id.description: Transaction to refund; must reference an existing, refundable transaction.

CreateScheduledTrip.description: Request body to book a scheduled trip.

dropoff_address.description: Optional human-readable dropoff address; omit to send coordinates only.

dropoff_lat.description: Dropoff latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

dropoff_lng.description: Dropoff longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

pickup_address.description: Optional human-readable pickup address; omit to send coordinates only.

pickup_lat.description: Pickup latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

pickup_lng.description: Pickup longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

scheduled_for.description: RFC3339 timestamp (UTC); must be between 30 minutes and 7 days from now, else 400.

star.description:
Desired car star class: 1, 2, or 3 (3 = nicest). Omit or null defaults to
star 1. Anything outside 1..=3 is rejected 400 rather than clamped: the
rider is committing to a price hours ahead of the ride, so a typo must
surface at booking time and not as a surprise fare at promotion.

trip_type.description: Kind of trip to create on promotion; must be "regular" (any other value is rejected 400).

CreateZone.description: Request body for creating a service zone (POST /api/admin/zones).

abriyah_base_fare_iqd.description: Abriyah flat base fare in integer IQD. Defaults to the settings value (or 0) when omitted.

abriyah_per_km_iqd.description: Abriyah per-kilometer fare in integer IQD. Defaults to the settings value when omitted; must resolve to > 0 for abriyah_enabled zones. Forced to null for regular_only zones.

active.description: Whether the zone is created active. Defaults to true when omitted.

allow_women_only.description: Whether to permit women-only Abriyah rooms. Defaults to true when omitted.

city_id.description: City the new zone belongs to; must reference an existing city or the request is rejected.

polygon_wkt.description: Zone boundary as WKT, longitude first, SRID 4326: `POLYGON((lng lat, ...))`. Must be a closed, valid (non-self-intersecting) polygon or the request is rejected.

room_max_riders.description: Maximum riders per Abriyah room. Defaults to the settings value (or 4) when omitted.

room_max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum room-open seconds before expiry. Defaults to the settings value (or 300) when omitted.

avg_rating_given.description: Average stars this rider gave to captains; null with no ratings given yet.

avg_rating_received.description: Average stars this rider received from captains; null with no ratings yet.

blocked.description: True if the customer is currently blocked from booking.

blocked_reason.description: Reason recorded when the customer was blocked; null when not blocked.

cancellation_count.description: Lifetime count of trips this rider cancelled.

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the account was created.

name.description: Display name; null when the rider has not set one.

total_trips.description: Lifetime count of trips this rider requested.

CustomerList.description: Customer list wrapper with pagination metadata.

items.description: Customer rows for the requested page.

page.description: 1-based page number echoed from the request.

per_page.description: Page size echoed from the request.

CustomerRow.description: A customer row for the All-Customers directory.

blocked.description: True if the customer is currently blocked from booking.

cancellation_count.description: Lifetime count of trips this rider cancelled.

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the account was created.

name.description: Display name; null when the rider has not set one.

total_trips.description: Lifetime count of trips this rider requested.

activated_captain_count.description: Captains who activated (paid the daily fee) in the bucket.

activation_rate_pct.description: Activation rate: activated / approved as a percentage, 0-100; derived in SQL.

approved_captain_count.description:
Approved captains in the city at snapshot time (absolute COUNT, refreshed
on each event -- not a running sum).

city_name.description: Human-readable city name; null if the city was deleted.

id.description: Unique identifier of this rollup row.

period_start.description: First calendar day of the bucket (Asia/Baghdad).

updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last upsert into this row.

DeleteCaptainAccountRequest.description:
Request body for DELETE /api/captain/me. Deleting an account is irreversible,
so the captain must re-enter their current password to prove the request came
from the account owner and not from a stolen or borrowed handset.

password.description:
The captain's current plaintext password, re-typed in the confirmation
dialog. Verified server-side against the stored hash; a mismatch is
rejected with 401 and body `{"error":"wrong_password"}`, and nothing is
deleted. Wrong passwords count toward the same lockout as login.

DeleteRiderAccountRequest.description:
Request body for DELETE /api/riders/me. Deleting an account is irreversible,
so the rider must re-enter their current password to prove the request came
from the account owner and not from a stolen or borrowed handset.

password.description:
The rider's current plaintext password, re-typed in the confirmation
dialog. Verified server-side against the stored hash; a mismatch is
rejected with 401 and body `{"error":"wrong_password"}`, and nothing is
deleted. Wrong passwords count toward the same lockout as login.

item_id.description: Identifier of the item to dismiss for the calling admin.

item_type.description: Tab the item belongs to: `flagged_trip` | `expired_room` | `stuck_item`. Any other value is rejected with 400.

DocumentCompletenessResponse.description: Document-upload completeness for a captain (drives the approval gate).

complete.description: True when every required document type has been uploaded; approval is blocked until then.

uploaded.description: Every document type the captain has uploaded (not filtered to the required set).

DocumentViewResponse.description: A short-lived presigned GET URL for an admin to view a stored document.

view_url.description: Presigned GET URL (short-lived). Open to view the image.

DropoffZoneInfo.description: The dropoff (destination) zone a room is keyed by.

EarningsHistoryItem.description: One completed-trip line in a captain's earnings history.

fare_iqd.description: Fare earned for this trip in integer IQD (no decimals).

trip_id.description: Trip that produced this earnings line.

EarningsHistoryResponse.description: A captain's itemised completed-trip earnings over a rolling period.

items.description: Completed-trip earnings lines within the window.

EarningsSummaryResponse.description: Captain earnings summary over a rolling period, net of the activation fee.

activation_fee_iqd.description: Flat activation fee subtracted from gross in integer IQD; 0 when gross is not positive. Exact for "today"; illustrative (a single fee, not per-day) over week/month in v1.

gross_iqd.description: Sum of completed-trip fares since the period start, in integer IQD.

net_iqd.description: Gross minus the activation fee, in integer IQD.

trip_count.description: Number of completed trips counted in the window.

ExpiredRoomRow.description: Needs-Action Tab 3: a recently expired room.

expired_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the room expired (derived from the expiry sweep's update time).

opened_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the room was opened.

rider_count_at_expiry.description: Number of riders in the room when it expired.

FareEstimateResponse.description: Pre-request fare estimate computed without persisting a trip.

base_fare_iqd.description: Flat base fare component in integer IQD, before the per-km charge.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code; always "IQD" in v1.

fare_iqd.description: Estimated total fare in integer IQD (no decimals).

final_fare_iqd.description: Fare after the discount: max(0, fare_iqd - discount_iqd).

FlaggedTripRow.description: Needs-Action Tab 2: a flagged trip (long-running, late cancel, or low rating).

avg_stars.description: Average star rating for the trip; only populated for the low-rating flag, otherwise null.

captain_name.description: Assigned captain's name; null if no captain was ever assigned.

flag_reason.description: Why the trip was flagged: `In-progress over 2 hours` | `Cancelled: captain late` | `Low rating`.

requested_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the trip was requested.

status_duration_min.description: Minutes elapsed since the trip was requested.

zone_name.description: Pickup zone name; null if the trip has no zone.

ForceActionRequest.description: Body for force-cancel (reason validated against the cancellation_reason enum).

reason.description: Cancellation reason; must be a valid value from the `cancellation_reason` enum.

gender.description: New gender to set on the customer: `m` | `f` | `unset`.

HealthResponse.description: Liveness payload returned by the process-level health probe.

status.description: Always the literal "ok" while the process is running.

version.description: Running server build, taken from the `beeb` crate version (semver).

email.description: Email for the new admin; must be unique (409 on collision) and is lowercased.

name.description: Display name for the new admin.

role.description: Role to grant: `super_admin` | `operator` | `finance`. Any other value is rejected.

send_invite.description:
When false, create the admin in `invited` status without sending the
invite email (it can be sent later via resend-invite). Defaults true.

JoinRoomRequest.description: Request to join (or open) an Abriyah shared-ride room for a rider.

pickup_lat.description: Pickup latitude (WGS84 decimal degrees); must fall inside an active zone polygon.

pickup_lng.description: Pickup longitude (WGS84 decimal degrees); must fall inside an active zone polygon.

room_type.description: Requested pool gender policy: "mixed" or "women_only"; "women_only" requires the rider to be a woman and the zone to allow it.

JoinRoomResponse.description: Result of joining a room: the room state, the rider's new seat, and the matched trip.

distance_km.description: This rider's pickup-to-dropoff distance in kilometers.

fare_iqd.description: This rider's individual fare in integer IQD (no decimals).

member.description: The rider's newly created membership (seat) in the room.

room.description: The room the rider joined, re-fetched after any auto-dispatch so its status is current.

trip_id.description: The Abriyah trip created and linked for this rider.

KpiSnapshot.description: KPI snapshot (8 dashboard cards + yesterday deltas), computed in one query.

activation_fees_accrued_iqd.description: Total activation fees accrued today, in integer IQD.

activations_today.description: Captain daily activations recorded today (Asia/Baghdad calendar day).

active_captains_now.description: Captains currently online (`captain_locations.online = TRUE`). Counts every online captain regardless of daily activation; not an activated-only count.

active_trips_now.description: Trips currently in a live state (requested, matched, accepted, or in_progress).

cancelled_today.description: Trips that were cancelled today (Asia/Baghdad calendar day).

completed_today.description: Trips that completed today (Asia/Baghdad calendar day).

completed_yesterday.description: Trips completed yesterday, for the day-over-day delta on the dashboard card.

open_rooms_now.description: Abriyah rooms currently open or locked.

trips_yesterday.description: Trips requested yesterday, for the day-over-day delta on the dashboard card.

LiveRoomCard.description: A live room card for the Operations Kanban.

captain_name.description: Assigned captain's name; null while no captain is dispatched.

max_riders.description: Maximum riders the room can hold.

max_wait_sec.description: Zone-configured max wait in seconds before the room expires.

opened_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the room was opened.

rider_count.description: Number of riders currently in the room.

status.description: Current room status (e.g. `open`, `locked`, `dispatched`).

wait_elapsed_sec.description: Seconds elapsed since the room opened.

LiveTripPin.description: A live trip pin for the Operations map.

captain_lat.description: Captain's last-known WGS84 latitude; null if no location ping is on file.

captain_lng.description: Captain's last-known WGS84 longitude; null if no location ping is on file.

captain_name.description: Assigned captain's name; null while the trip is unassigned.

captain_phone.description: Assigned captain's phone; null while the trip is unassigned.

requested_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the trip was requested.

rider_count.description: Number of riders on the trip (at least 1; counts room members for Abriyah).

status.description: Current trip status (e.g. `requested`, `matched`, `accepted`, `in_progress`).

status_duration_min.description: Minutes elapsed since the trip was requested.

zone_name.description: Pickup zone name; null if the trip has no zone.

LocationPingInput.description:
Body for `POST /api/captain/location`: a single GPS ping.

`longitude` / `latitude` are required; the motion fields are optional so that
older Captain App builds keep working unchanged. Supplying them is what lets
the rider's map rotate the car marker and interpolate between pings instead
of teleporting the pin, so new builds should always send what the platform
location API reports.

accuracy_m.description: Horizontal accuracy radius of the fix in metres, >= 0. Omit when unknown.

heading_deg.description:
Direction of travel in degrees clockwise from true north, in [0, 360).
Omit (or send null) when the platform reports no bearing -- do not send 0,
which means "heading due north".

speed_mps.description: Ground speed in metres per second, >= 0. Omit when unknown.

Message.description: A single rider<->captain chat message on a trip thread.

read_at.description: When the counterparty first saw the message (RFC3339). Null while unread.

sender_id.description: Sender principal id: a rider (users.id) or a captain (captains.id).

trip_id.description:
Trip this message belongs to (the conversation key). For Abriyah, each
rider has their own trip, so this is a 1:1 rider<->captain thread.

MessageResponse.description: A simple human-readable acknowledgement for actions with no resource body.

message.description: Human-readable status message describing the action's outcome.

MessagesPage.description: A page of chat history, newest-last, with a keyset cursor.

has_more.description:
True when older messages exist before `items[0]` (page again with
`?before=items[0].created_at`).

items.description: Messages ordered oldest-first within the page.

NearbyCar.description:
One car in the rider's idle-map ambience feed
(`GET /api/rider/captains/nearby`).

This shape is the privacy boundary: the endpoint hands workforce positions to
*any* logged-in rider, so the struct carries only what a moving marker needs
and deliberately has no room for anything else -- no name, phone, plate, star,
rating, trip state, and never the captain's id. Adding a field here widens
what every rider can see about every captain on shift; treat it as a
deliberate policy change, not a convenience.

heading_deg.description:
Direction of travel in degrees clockwise from true north, in [0, 360).
Null when the device reported none (typically while stopped); keep the
marker at its last rotation rather than snapping it to north.

id.description:
Opaque per-day pseudonym, stable for one Asia/Baghdad calendar day so the
client can animate the same car between polls, and unlinkable to the same
captain tomorrow. Not a captain id and not resolvable to one.

latitude.description:
WGS-84 latitude, rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m) -- deliberately coarser
than the captain's real fix.

longitude.description: WGS-84 longitude, rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m).

NearbyCarsResponse.description:
Response for `GET /api/rider/captains/nearby`: the anonymized cars inside the
rider's visible map viewport. Empty when no captain is on shift there -- an
empty list is a normal answer, not an error state.

cars.description: Anonymized cars in the viewport, nearest to its centre first.

NeedsActionCounts.description: Badge counts for the 4 Needs-Action tabs.

any_sla_breach.description: True if any pending captain has waited > 24h.

expired_rooms.description: Rooms that expired in the last 24h and are not yet dismissed (Tab 3 badge count).

flagged_trips.description: Flagged trips not yet dismissed by this admin (Tab 2 badge count).

stuck_items.description: Stuck items not yet dismissed by this admin (Tab 4 badge count).

NotificationLog.description: Delivery record for an FCM push or SMS attempt. Retention 90 days.

NotificationType.description:
Category of a push notification the platform sends to a rider or captain.

Serialized in snake_case and persisted to `notification_log.notification_type`.
Allowed values: `trip_accepted` | `captain_arriving` | `trip_completed` |
`trip_cancelled` | `room_dispatched` | `room_expired` |
`captain_approval_decision` | `new_trip_in_queue` | `chat_message`.

OfflinePingFlushInput.description:
Body for `POST /api/captain/location/flush`: ordered pings collected while the
captain app was offline. The backend stores only the last one (last-known
interpolation policy).

pings.description:
GPS pings buffered while offline, in chronological order (oldest first).
Must be non-empty; an empty array is rejected with 400. Only the last
entry is persisted as the new last-known position.

OkResponse.description:
An empty success body for endpoints that only return a status (e.g. online
toggle), so Swagger shows a concrete schema.

OnlineToggleInput.description: Body for `PUT /api/captain/online`: toggle the captain's online state.

online.description:
Desired availability: `true` to go online (subject to the daily
activation gate), `false` to go offline.

PaymentMethod.description: A saved payment instrument for a rider or captain. The gateway token is never exposed.

is_default.description: True if this is the owner's default method used when none is specified.

masked_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card for display. Null for non-card methods such as wallet.

owner_id.description: Identifier of the rider or captain that owns this method.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last change, e.g. when the default flag was toggled (RFC3339).

PaymentOrder.description:
A QiCard hosted-form checkout. Ties our internal purpose (what is being paid
for) to the QiCard `paymentId`, so a SUCCESS (sandbox auto-confirm or live
webhook) fulfils the right thing. The card is never entered on our side; the
payer completes payment on QiCard's hosted form at `form_url`.

amount_iqd.description: Amount in integer IQD (no decimals); always positive.

form_url.description: The hosted-form URL to redirect the payer to. Null if create failed.

gateway_payment_id.description: QiCard's paymentId. Null only if the create call failed.

owner_id.description: Rider or captain initiating the checkout.

paid_at.description: When the order settled (RFC3339). Null until paid.

request_id.description: Our unique requestId sent to QiCard (unique per terminal).

sandbox_autoconfirmed.description: True when settled by sandbox auto-confirm rather than a real QiCard SUCCESS.

status.description: Lifecycle: "created" | "paid" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "refunded".

target_id.description:
Fulfilment target. The trip id ("trip_fare") or activation id
("daily_fee"); null for "wallet_topup".

transaction_id.description: Ledger transaction created on fulfilment. Null until paid.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last status change (RFC3339).

PendingCaptainRow.description: Needs-Action Tab 1: a captain awaiting approval.

documents_complete.description: True when at least 5 documents have been uploaded (the approval requirement).

sla_breached.description: True when `age_hours` exceeds the 24h approval SLA.

PhoneStatusRequest.description:
POST /api/auth/phone-status body. Lets the client check, right after the
phone field, whether to show Login vs Signup (before sending an OTP).

phone.description: International phone, with or without leading '+', 10-15 digits.

PhoneStatusResponse.description: Returned by POST /api/auth/phone-status: which account types own this phone.

captain_exists.description: An active (non-archived) captain account exists for this phone.

phone.description: Normalized phone (digits only, no leading '+') the status was computed for.

registered.description:
Convenience: `rider_exists || captain_exists`. When true, the app should
route to Login instead of Signup.

rider_exists.description: A rider account exists for this phone.

PickupZoneCount.description: Count of riders in a room being picked up from one pickup zone.

name.description: Pickup zone English name; null for the unknown-zone group.

name_ar.description: Pickup zone Arabic name; null for the unknown-zone group.

rider_count.description: Number of riders in this room picked up from this zone.

zone_id.description: Pickup zone id; null when the riders' pickups fell outside all active zones.

Place.description:
One POI returned by the map overlay. `lat`/`lng` are WGS84; geometry never
crosses into Rust as a spatial type -- the repo projects it to scalars via
`ST_X`/`ST_Y` (same convention as captain locations).

address.description: Optional formatted address (Latin); null when unknown.

address_ar.description: Optional formatted address (Arabic); null when unknown.

distance_m.description:
Straight-line distance from the query point in metres. Only present on
radius (`lat`/`lng`) queries; null for bbox queries.

id.description: OSM feature id, e.g. `node/123456` or `way/456` (centroid for ways).

name.description: Display/Latin name; may be null where OSM has no usable name.

name_ar.description: Arabic name; may be null (only ~half of Iraqi POIs carry `name:ar`).

PlacesNearbyResponse.description:
Paginated `{ items, total, page, per_page }` envelope, matching the other
list endpoints (trips, captains, zones).

page.description: 1-based page number of this result set.

per_page.description: Maximum number of places returned per page.

total.description: Total matching places across all pages (capped; see handler docs).

PreferenceKeySchema.description:
One entry in the preference allow-list: a known key and the values it
accepts. Returned by `GET /api/admin/me/preferences/schema` so the dashboard
reads the allow-list from the backend instead of hardcoding it.

allowed_values.description: The values accepted for this key, in display order.

PresignedUploadResponse.description:
Presigned upload target. The client PUTs the raw image bytes to `upload_url`
(direct to storage, NOT through the API), then submits `object_key` back to
`POST .../documents`.

object_key.description: The object key to submit when persisting the document.

upload_url.description: Presigned PUT URL (short-lived). PUT the image bytes here directly.

PricingUpdateResult.description: Result of a pricing change, pairing the updated zone with how many active trips were re-priced.

in_flight_trips_locked.description: Count of non-terminal trips in this zone (status NOT IN 'completed','cancelled') at the time of the change. The handler only counts these trips; it does not lock or re-price any of them.

zone.description: The zone after the pricing/room fields were applied.

ProxySession.description: A masked phone-proxy session that hides the rider's and captain's real numbers for a single live trip.

captain_proxy_number.description: Masked number the captain dials to reach the rider; the rider's real phone is never exposed.

created_at.description: When this session row was first inserted (RFC3339); preserved across in-place re-allocations of an expired session.

expires_at.description: When the masking expires (RFC3339); 2 hours after allocation. A read after this re-allocates the masking in place, refreshing the numbers and this `expires_at` on the same row.

provider.description: Number-proxy provider that allocated the masking, e.g. "mock" in the current build.

provider_session_id.description: Provider-side session handle for releasing the masking; null when the provider returns none.

rider_proxy_number.description: Masked number the rider dials to reach the captain; the captain's real phone is never exposed.

trip_id.description: The trip this session masks; one active session per trip.

QiCardWebhook.description:
The fields we read from a QiCard webhook payload. QiCard sends the full
payment object; we read the ones needed for fulfilment + signature
verification. Unknown fields are ignored.

amount.description: Total amount QiCard reports for the payment (used to cross-check the order).

creationDate.description: QiCard creation date (part of the signed data string).

currency.description: Currency code (part of the signed data string).

status.description: Payment status: SUCCESS | PENDING | FAILURE / FAILED / AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.

Rating.description:
A star rating left for one party on a trip.

Exactly one of `by_user_id`/`by_captain_id` identifies the rater and exactly
one of `of_user_id`/`of_captain_id` identifies the ratee (enforced by DB
CHECKs). A rating becomes read-only once locked.

by_captain_id.description: Rater when a captain left the rating. Set iff the rater is a captain; null when a rider rated.

by_user_id.description: Rater when a rider left the rating. Set iff the rater is a rider; null when a captain rated.

comment.description: Optional free-text comment. Null when none was provided.

locked_at.description: When the rating became read-only (RFC3339). Set to the sweep time (`NOW()`) by `RatingRepository::lock_expired`, which only affects rows older than 7 days; the value is therefore at or after `created_at` + 7 days, not exactly `created_at` + 7 days. No scheduler invokes this sweep in the running service, so in practice this stays null until `lock_expired` is run explicitly.

of_captain_id.description: Ratee when the rated party is a captain. Set iff the rider rated the captain; otherwise null.

of_user_id.description: Ratee when the rated party is a rider. Set iff the captain rated the rider; otherwise null.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp (RFC3339).

UpdateVehicleRequest.description:
Restate a captain's car. Replaces the whole vehicle block in one PUT.

Field names and semantics are deliberately identical to the vehicle half of
[`RegisterCaptainRequest`], so the Captain App can reuse the registration
form for editing: `car_make`/`car_model` are the required free text every
shipped build sends, the catalog ids are the accurate identification layered
on top, and `car_year` is what the star grade turns on.

This is a PUT, not a PATCH: `car_color` and `car_year` are CLEARED when
omitted, exactly as omitting them at registration would have left them
unset. Send the values you want to keep. Omitting `car_year` therefore
drops the captain to star 1 (no year clears any age gate), which is the
same trap registration has always had and the reason the app should always
send the full block.

`car_brand_id` / `car_model_id` are the exception and do NOT clear: they are
stored as whatever the grader RESOLVED, which -- when you send no ids -- is
whatever the free-text make/model fuzzy-matches in the catalog. Sending the
free text alone therefore re-derives the same match rather than clearing it;
the only way to change the catalog identification is to send the ids you
want. Read them back off the 200 body to see what was stored.

`car_plate` is NOT here on purpose: the plate is the car's legal identity,
is unique across captains, and is on the rider's screen and the trip record.
Changing it is a different, heavier operation than fixing a mistyped year.

car_brand_id.description:
Catalog brand id, from `GET /api/vehicle-catalog/brands`. Optional, but
when `car_model_id` is also sent the two must agree (else 400).

car_color.description: Vehicle color. Optional; omitted clears the stored color.

car_make.description:
Vehicle manufacturer, e.g. "Toyota". Required and non-empty, as at
registration: the catalog ids are additive, not a replacement, and every
rider-facing screen reads this text.

car_model.description: Vehicle model, e.g. "Corolla". Required and non-empty.

car_model_id.description:
Catalog model id, from `GET /api/vehicle-catalog/brands/{id}/models`.
Optional; when sent it must exist in the catalog (else 400). This is what
lifts the car above an age-only grade, so sending it is how a captain
reaches star 3 at all.

car_year.description:
Vehicle model year, e.g. 2019. Optional but strongly recommended: with no
year the car clears no age gate and grades to star 1. When supplied it
must be in 1970..=2100 (else 400).

UpdateZone.description: Partial-update body for a zone (PUT /api/admin/zones/{id}). Every field is optional; omitted fields keep their current value.

abriyah_base_fare_iqd.description: New Abriyah flat base fare in integer IQD. Omit to leave unchanged.

abriyah_per_km_iqd.description: New Abriyah per-kilometer fare in integer IQD. When the resulting type is abriyah_enabled, the effective rate (this value or the existing one) must be > 0. Omit to leave unchanged.

active.description: New active flag. Omit to leave unchanged.

allow_women_only.description: New women-only permission flag. Omit to leave unchanged.

expected_version.description:
Optimistic-lock guard. When supplied, the update is rejected with 409 if
the zone's current `version` differs (someone else edited it since you
loaded it). Omit to skip the check (last-write-wins, backward compatible).

name.description: New zone name (English/Latin). Omit to leave unchanged.

name_ar.description: New zone name in Arabic. Omit to leave unchanged.

polygon_wkt.description: New boundary as WKT, longitude first, SRID 4326. Must be a closed, valid polygon when supplied. Omit to leave unchanged.

room_max_riders.description: New maximum riders per Abriyah room. Omit to leave unchanged.

room_max_wait_seconds.description: New maximum room-open seconds before expiry. Omit to leave unchanged.

zone_type.description: New service type; when supplied must be "regular_only" or "abriyah_enabled". Omit to leave unchanged.

UpdateZonePricing.description: Pricing/room-only partial-update body (PUT /api/admin/zones/{id}/pricing). Omitted fields keep their current value; geometry and identity are not touched.

abriyah_base_fare_iqd.description: New Abriyah flat base fare in integer IQD. Omit to leave unchanged.

abriyah_per_km_iqd.description: New Abriyah per-kilometer fare in integer IQD. Omit to leave unchanged.

allow_women_only.description: New women-only permission flag. Omit to leave unchanged.

room_max_riders.description: New maximum riders per Abriyah room. Omit to leave unchanged.

room_max_wait_seconds.description: New maximum room-open seconds before expiry. Omit to leave unchanged.

UploadDocumentRequest.description: Persist one captain document after a presigned upload (or via a self-hosted URL).

doc_type.description:
Document type. Allowed values: "driver_license" | "car_registration" |
"captain_selfie" | "national_id_front" | "national_id_back". Any other value is rejected.

object_key.description:
Presigned-upload flow: the `object_key` returned by
`POST .../documents/upload-url` after the client PUT the image to it.
Preferred. When set, the backend stores the key and serves the document
back via a short-lived presigned GET URL.

url.description:
Legacy / bring-your-own flow: a full HTTPS URL the client already hosts.
Used only when `object_key` is absent. Storing PII this way has no
access control -- prefer the presigned-upload flow.

UpsertPreference.description:
Upsert body for `PUT /api/admin/me/preferences`. The key/value are validated
against the `AppPrefKey` allow-list in [`AppPreferencesService`].

pref_key.description:
Preference name; must be on the server allow-list (`operations.live_rooms.view`
or `captains.pending.view`). An unknown key is rejected with 400.

pref_value.description:
New value; must be one of the allowed values for `pref_key`
(`table` | `kanban` for `operations.live_rooms.view`,
`table` | `inbox` for `captains.pending.view`). An invalid value is
rejected with 400.

User.description: Rider account. Created or looked up by phone number on OTP verification.

blocked.description: True when the account is blocked by an admin and cannot request trips.

blocked_reason.description: Admin-supplied reason for the block. Null when `blocked` is false.

gender.description:
Gender: "m" | "f" | "unset". Stored as a DB enum, selected as text. Drives
women-only (Abriyah) eligibility; "unset" means the rider has not declared one.

name.description: Display name. Null until the rider sets it during profile completion.

phone.description:
Rider phone in normalized digits-only form (no leading '+'); the unique login
identity (OTP is sent here). Normalization strips any leading '+' and stores 10-15
ASCII digits.

photo_url.description: URL of the rider's avatar image. Null until a photo is uploaded.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp (RFC3339, UTC). Equals `created_at` for a brand-new row.

ValidatePinsRequest.description: Per-drag pin validation request (G-MF-03): checks pickup/dropoff fall in a serviceable zone.

zone_id.description:
Deprecated/ignored: retained for backward compatibility with older clients.
Pin validation now resolves the dropoff and pickup zones independently and
does not use this hint.

ValidatePinsResponse.description:
Per-drag pin validation result; never an HTTP error. Validates the two ends
independently: dropoff must be in an Abriyah zone, pickup in any active zone.

dropoff_zone_id.description: The resolved Abriyah dropoff zone; null when the dropoff is not in an Abriyah zone.

message.description: Human-readable explanation shown inline in the Customer App.

pickup_zone_id.description: The resolved active pickup zone; null when the pickup is outside all active zones.

valid.description: True when the dropoff is in an Abriyah-enabled zone AND the pickup is in some active zone.

ValidatePolygonRequest.description: Request body for the polygon-validation endpoint (POST /api/admin/zones/validate-polygon).

polygon_wkt.description: Candidate polygon as WKT, longitude first, SRID 4326: `POLYGON((lng lat, ...))`. Checked for validity without creating a zone.

valid.description: True when the submitted WKT is a closed, non-self-intersecting polygon usable as a zone boundary.

fare_iqd.description: Optional fare to compute the exact discount against.

ValidatePromoResponse.description: Rider validate response. Never an HTTP error; `valid` carries the outcome.

VehicleBrand.description: A vehicle brand, as offered in the captain app's picker.

is_premium.description: Luxury marque. Exposed so the app can group or badge premium brands.

name_ar.description: Arabic name, e.g. "تويوتا". The captain app is Arabic-first.

VehicleModel.description:
A vehicle model belonging to a brand.

The quality indices are deliberately NOT exposed here: they are an internal
grading input, and publishing them would invite captains to shop for a model
that games the classifier rather than describe the car they actually drive.

VehicleModelWithBrand.description: A model plus its brand's display name, for search results.

VerifyOtpRequest.description: POST /api/auth/otp/verify body: verify a code and receive a short-lived ticket.

code.description: The plaintext one-time code; checked against the stored hash.

phone.description: International phone, with or without leading '+', 10-15 digits.

WaiveActivationRequest.description: Admin: waive a daily activation fee.

Wallet.description: A prepaid balance account belonging to one rider or captain.

balance_iqd.description: Current spendable balance in integer IQD (no decimals); never negative.

owner_id.description: Identifier of the rider or captain that owns this wallet.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last balance or metadata change (RFC3339).

WriteAuditLog.description: Internal write DTO for an audit entry (not a public endpoint body).

WriteNotificationLog.description: Internal write DTO for queuing a notification delivery record.

Zone.description:
A service zone: a PostGIS polygon (lng/lat, SRID 4326) plus per-zone Abriyah
pricing and room settings. The polygon is exchanged as WKT text.

abriyah_base_fare_iqd.description: Abriyah flat base fare in integer IQD added to the distance charge.

abriyah_per_km_iqd.description: Abriyah per-kilometer fare in integer IQD. Null for regular_only zones; always > 0 for abriyah_enabled zones.

active.description: Whether the zone is live and usable for dispatch. False once archived.

allow_women_only.description: Whether this zone permits women-only Abriyah rooms.

archived_at.description: Archival timestamp (RFC3339). Null while the zone is active.

archived_by.description: Admin user who archived the zone. Null while the zone is active.

created_by.description: Admin user who created the zone.

edited_by.description: Admin user who last edited the zone. Null until the zone is edited after creation.

polygon_wkt.description: Zone boundary as WKT, longitude first, SRID 4326, e.g. `POLYGON((lng lat, ...))`. Read from PostGIS via `ST_AsText`.

room_max_riders.description: Maximum riders allowed per Abriyah room in this zone.

room_max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum seconds an Abriyah room stays open for matching before it expires.

updated_at.description: Last-update timestamp (RFC3339).

version.description: Optimistic-lock version; incremented on every update.

zone_type.description: Service type: "regular_only" | "abriyah_enabled". Only abriyah_enabled zones carry a per-km rate.

ZoneImportReport.description: Summary of a bulk import run, reporting how many rows were committed versus failed.

committed.description: Number of rows that validated and were inserted.

errors.description: One entry per failed row, with its position and reason.

failed.description: Number of rows that failed and were skipped.

ZoneImportRequest.description: Request wrapper for the bulk zone import endpoint (POST /api/admin/zones/import).

rows.description: Zones to import; each row is validated and committed independently (partial success allowed).

ZoneImportRow.description: A single zone to create via the bulk import endpoint. The city is resolved by name rather than id.

abriyah_base_fare_iqd.description: Abriyah flat base fare in integer IQD. Defaults to 0 when omitted; the bulk-import path does no settings lookup (unlike POST /api/admin/zones).

abriyah_per_km_iqd.description: Abriyah per-kilometer fare in integer IQD. Required and must be > 0 for abriyah_enabled rows; ignored (forced null) for regular_only rows.

active.description: Whether the zone is created active. Defaults to true when omitted.

allow_women_only.description: Whether to permit women-only Abriyah rooms. Defaults to true when omitted.

city_name.description: City name used to look up the target city; the row fails if no city matches.

polygon_wkt.description: Zone boundary as WKT, longitude first, SRID 4326. Must be a closed, valid polygon or the row fails.

room_max_riders.description: Maximum riders per Abriyah room. Defaults to 4 when omitted; the bulk-import path does no settings lookup (unlike POST /api/admin/zones).

room_max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum room-open seconds before expiry. Defaults to 300 when omitted; the bulk-import path does no settings lookup (unlike POST /api/admin/zones).

zone_type.description: Service type; must be "regular_only" or "abriyah_enabled" or the row fails.

ZoneImportRowError.description: A single failed import row and why it was rejected.

message.description: Human-readable failure reason (e.g. unknown zone_type, city not found, invalid polygon).

row.description: 1-based row index in the submitted batch.
